units.source_text: 写在像阴天一般灰色的纸上。

en.t: It was written on gray paper like an overcast sky.

units.source_text: 为欲牵引这少年女子的注目，字迹写得特别秀美，教人看了赏心悦目。

en.t: To draw the young woman's attention, the handwriting had been made especially graceful, pleasing to the eye of anyone who saw it.

units.source_text: 前斋宫得了信不敢作复，十分狼狈。

en.t: When the former High Priestess received the letter, she did not dare to reply and was terribly flustered.

units.source_text: 旁人都督促她，说代笔是不成体统的。

en.t: Everyone around her urged her on, saying that having someone else write for her would be improper.

units.source_text: 便用一张灰色纸，浓重地熏透了香，又把墨色调得浓淡恰好，然后写上一首答诗：

en.t: So she took a sheet of gray paper, thoroughly infused it with a rich fragrance, adjusted the ink to just the right depth of tone, and then wrote a poem in reply:
